name: Synn
message: 「Come on, Azel. You were skipping class again, weren't you.」

name: Synn
message: 「As the Student Council President, I can't just look the other way.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is peeking into other people's private lives a hobby of yours.」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, you really should go to class...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Class is starting soon. Get back to your classroom.」

name: Synn
message: 「You shouldn't talk to a teacher like that.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「It's nothing for you to worry about.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Come on, break time is almost over.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You were awesome in that fight just now.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph. Not bad at all, for Sakura-kun.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, I'm sure it's all thanks to everyone.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whaaat are you stating the obvious for!」

name: Misa
message: 「Good grief. Even though he's normally so pathetic.」
Still, I definitely feel like demon hunting has been going a lot more smoothly lately.
Is it just that I'm getting used to it, or am I actually getting stronger?
Well, either way, it's a good thing.
